title: Seven orders of compute in eleven years
caption: log10 FLOPs of landmark training runs: AlexNet ~10^18, BERT-Large ~10^20, GPT-3 ~3×10^23, PaLM ~10^24, GPT-4-class ~10^25. Roughly half the growth is fleet size and duration rather than per-device speed.

title: Inside the 8.71-second step — 1,024-GPU reference job
caption: Only 7.25 s of the measured step does arithmetic. The 0.53 s pipeline bubble and 0.93 s gradient exchange (~17% combined) are the terms fleet growth taxes first — and they do not shrink linearly when you add GPUs.
